_readme: State allow-list for tools/generate_location_pages.py (D-345, gh-2422). Maintained by the CRO. SHIPS EMPTY: the generator emits pages ONLY for states listed in "states". To add a state: (1) complete that state's D-344 statute search; (2) confirm data/us-counties.json has the state and tools/generate_location_pages.py has a STATE_PROFILES entry for it (the generator errors out loudly if either is missing); (3) add the two-letter code to "states" in a PR. See tools/README-locations-workflow.md.
